Two reviews I read (MountGuys and The Gadgeteer) agree on the same few mounts. I couldn't open the WIRED guide. Prices below come from the articles and change often, so check them before you buy.

**Best overall: LISEN Qi2.2 25W Car Mount with Cooling Fan, about $39.95**
- It has the highest wattage in the roundup (up to 25W) and a fan to prevent heat throttling. It also includes a 95W car adapter.
- It mounts on the dash with a suction base. The base is large, and with the fan off, output drops to 15W.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)

**Most reliable, vent mount: Anker Prime Qi2 25W, about $70–90**
- It has both thermoelectric cooling and a fan, a 60W adapter in the box, and a two-year warranty. MountGuys tested it hands-on and liked the strong hold.
- It costs the most of the group. The vent clip is narrow, so check that it fits your vent slats.
- [Buy](https://pboost.me/p1SMdJ7da) (Amazon link via The Gadgeteer)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock CryoBoost 15W, about $33–40**
- It has fan cooling at a lower price and works on a vent or the dash. The vent clip holds larger Pro Max phones well.
- It doesn't include a car charger. You'll need an 18W or faster adapter.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20)
- A deal site lists a code, PARTNER18, that takes $7.19 off at ESR's store ($39.99 to $32.80). I haven't verified it. [Deal page](https://dealectric.com/lab/V1/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other picks**
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2 (about $42):** It includes a car charger and has a ball joint for portrait or landscape. It has no fan. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20)
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2 (about $60):** It fits existing mount arms and has an NFC Shortcut trigger. It has no fan, so it may throttle on hot days. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20)
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W Vent Clip (about $36–40):** It's the cheapest 25W option and has no fan. It needs a 30W+ PD charger. [Link](https://pboost.me/a1SMF2dk)
- **ESR HaloLock Qi2 (about $20–27):** It's the cheapest option. It has no fan and no car charger. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20)
- **Cup holder: EXELIQ 15W:** Use it if your vents and dash won't work. The phone sits low, so it's better for charging than for navigation. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20)

**Buying tips**
- Most car USB ports give only 5–7.5W. You'll need a PD car charger to get full speed.
- Hot, sunny cabins are where chargers without fans slow down. Choose a fan model if you live somewhere warm.
- Some states restrict windshield mounts, so check your local rules before using a suction mount there.

If you tell me your phone and whether you prefer vent or dash, I can narrow this to one pick.

## Pros and Cons

**1. LISEN Qi2.2 25W Fan Mount (best overall)**
- Pros: Highest wattage in the roundup, active fan cooling, 95W car adapter included.
- Cons: Fan-off mode caps output at 15W. The large suction base can look oversized in small cabins.

**2. Anker Prime (best for reliability)**
- Pros: Combines thermoelectric cooling with a fan, 25W certified, 60W adapter included, two-year warranty.
- Cons: Most expensive pick. The vent clip is narrow, so check your vent blade width. Full 25W requires a 45W+ adapter.

**3. PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2 (best design)**
- Pros: NFC chip can trigger a preset iPhone Shortcut when you tap the mount. Aramid fiber build. Works with existing mount arms.
- Cons: No fan, so throttling is likely on hot, sunny days.

**4. ESR HaloLock CryoBoost (best value with fan)**
- Pros: Fan cooling at a lower price. Vent clip holds larger Pro Max models well.
- Cons: The 18W car adapter isn't included, adding roughly $10 to $15.

**5. iOttie Velox Mini Qi2 (best included charger)**
- Pros: Car charger included. Ball joint allows portrait or landscape positioning. Two-year warranty.
- Cons: No fan. Windshield mounting may be restricted in some states, and the article advises checking your state's rules.

**6. LISEN Qi2.2 25W Vent Clip (best budget 25W)**
- Pros: 25W ceiling at a lower price than the fan model. Hook clip is designed for deeper vent blades.
- Cons: No fan. Needs a separate 30W+ PD charger to reach 25W. Cabin temps above 95°F may trigger throttling.

**7. ESR HaloLock Qi2 (best entry pick)**
- Pros: Lowest-priced Qi2-certified 15W mount in the roundup. One-hand portrait/landscape switching.
- Cons: No car charger included (budget an 18W+ adapter). No active cooling.

## Notes
- The article lists different prices for several products in different sections, so verify current prices on Amazon before buying.
- The article says most car USB ports deliver only 5W to 7.5W, so a dedicated PD car charger is usually needed for full speed.
